steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Art, Craft and Design title requires research across MULTIPLE disciplines — not just fine art, but craft and design contexts too. | Key Fact: Understanding different purposes: art (personal expression), craft (material mastery), design (problem-solving) — each discipline has different values and approaches. | Key Fact: Comparing practitioners across disciplines reveals how the SAME theme can be explored through different media, techniques and intentions. | Key Fact: Your research must be CONNECTED to your own work — show how understanding a practitioner's approach has TRANSFORMED your thinking and practice.
